updates.sentence: Documented in custody at Allenwood, Pennsylvania in September–October and November–December 1968. Exact sentence, actual duration and custody endpoints remain unverified. Publication dates are not arrest or release dates. The March-April 1969 CCCO News Notes roster also lists him as currently imprisoned at Allenwood. This later listing establishes custody at the reporting period, not continuous confinement from the earlier lists or an exact endpoint. Source: https://vva.vietnam.ttu.edu/images.php?img=%2Fimages%2F1451%2F14511004038.pdf#page=4

expected.charges: Military conscientious resistance — individual charge unverified
expected.sentence: Listed in custody at Portsmouth Naval Correctional Institution, New Hampshire in the combined May–June–July–August 1969 issue and September–October 1969. Exact individual sentence, actual duration and entry/release dates remain unverified. Robert S. Vogel, writing for Friends Journal on April 1, 1969 (printed page 215), identifies Blanton as a Marine who sought support from Orange Grove Friends Meeting and was subsequently arrested outside the Resistance House in San Diego. The report does not give the arrest day, a court-martial judgment or a release date. Source: https://friendsjournal.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/friendsjournal/wp-content/uploads/emember/downloads/1969/HC12-50451.pdf#page=23
